section_summary.extract_value: This section compares the findings of 'our study' with those of Benedek, Jauk, Sommer, et al. (2014) regarding the relationship between divergent thinking and Executive Functions (EFs). 'Our study' found that updating abilities predicted fluency of divergent thinking, but not originality, and used the ATTA task (both figural and verbal) for creativity and ICAR for general cognitive ability. In contrast, Benedek et al. (2014) found divergent thinking predicted by updating abilities using a verbal-only creativity assessment.
